units.source_text: 要不然就是女人压根儿不信他有病，为了证实疑问，她也许以此来试探吧……

en.t: Or else the woman did not believe he was sick at all, and perhaps she was testing him this way to confirm her suspicions...
It was possible... he must not let himself be confused.

units.source_text: 女人的引诱，原来是糖衣炮弹。

en.t: The woman's seduction, it turned out, was a sugar-coated shell.

units.source_text: 也许不过是食肉植物布下的罗网，或是撒下“暴行”丑闻的种子，

en.t: Perhaps it was nothing more than a snare laid by a carnivorous plant, or the seed of a scandal about "violence" being sown,

units.source_text: 接着，恐吓之锁，就会来捆住他的手脚……

en.t: and then the chains of intimidation would come to bind his hands and feet...
